title: A novel nomogram for survival prediction in renal cell carcinoma patients with brain metastases: an analysis of the SEER database.
summary: XGBoost and random forest screening informed a renal-cancer survival nomogram, while a propensity-matched SEER analysis found an observational surgery-survival association.
ai_technology: SEER training and validation cohorts (982 and 420 patients) were analyzed; Cox model, calibration, ROC, decision curves and matching assess results.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: This qualifies as retrospective clinical prediction; the surgery association remains observational and potentially confounded, not causal.
